metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Wojciech Kucha: mods, skills and tools

plugins.name: lucid
plugins.description: Restrained, readable transcript for dark and light terminals: warm greys, one accent, AA contrast, quiet tool rows. A mouse selection pastes rendered prose and code lines exactly as written; for the markdown source use copy-that.

plugins.name: copy-that
plugins.description: Copy what Claude wrote as raw text: reply markdown, code blocks, tables, files Claude read or wrote, plans and tool output, by hover chip or /copy-that

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Draws mermaid sequence diagrams from Claude's replies as text in the terminal

plugins.name: peek
plugins.description: Shows images inline in the transcript: pasted, read, written and linked in replies, with a button to open each in Preview and /peek to put an image on the clipboard
